caption: The drawing depicts a four-poster bed frame rendered in brown tones. The structure consists of four tall, vertical corner posts with square bases, and each post is connected by horizontal rails at the top, forming a rectangular canopy. The horizontal rails at the bottom create the rectangular foundation of the bed. At the head of the bed, there is a wooden headboard, which features a simple rectangular design with a slight upward flare and small decorative scrolls on each end. The illustration is composed in a three-quarter perspective view, and the entire composition is set against a plain, light beige background. There are no additional objects or ornamentation present in the drawing.
title: Four Post Bed
